We have a proposed ten-year worldwide exclusive license with a 5% royalty on net sales and unrestricted sublicensing, and HelioGrid wants execution by June 30 to align with their planned commercial launch. No license has been signed yet. I'd like to hear from the team on where we stand and what concerns we need to address before we can move forward.

The royalty is set at exactly 6% of net sales, not the 5% in the draft. And sublicensing is prohibited, not unrestricted as proposed. HelioGrid's sponsor indicated they will not sign on the broader draft terms currently under discussion. I apologize for not getting this into the tracker sooner, but we need to reconcile the draft with these approved terms before any execution can happen.

We need to address this before any execution.
